featured_reviews.name: Tanveer Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a father of two children at Orchids International School - Kurla, my experience has been decent but with some concerns.

While the school has a good curriculum and infrastructure, there are areas that need improvement.

The Positives:

Qualified Teachers – Most teachers are caring and make efforts to engage students.

Good Facilities – The classrooms and playgrounds are well-maintained.

Extracurricular Activities – A decent variety of activities to keep kids interested.

Areas for Improvement:
Communication Gaps – Sometimes, updates about school events or academic progress are delayed or unclear.

Homework & Workload – My son often feels overwhelmed with assignments.

Limited Individual Attention

The school has potential but needs better communication, workload management, and more focus on individual student needs. Hoping for positive changes in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Vaishali Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: This college in Mulund is honestly one of the worst environments for students. There is a complete lack of basic manners, ethics & professionalism among the staff. The way students & even parents are spoken to is extremely disrespectful. Teachers use very casual & inappropriate language that doesn't belong in an educational institution. For example, statements like "aare tu idhar se nikal ja bhai" are used by Regina ma'am which clearly reflects the level of unprofessionalism. Instead of guidance & support, students are often talked down to in a rude & dismissive manner, which is disturbing. The administration focuses more on collecting money than actually supporting students. Fines are imposed for unnecessary reasons, like being late & even mobile phones are confiscated with a ₹500 charge. This feels less like discipline & more like a way to extract money. The management is also highly unprofessional. People are made to wait for hours without proper communication or courtesy. There is no sense of responsibility or respect in how things are handled. Some staff members & teachers like Najuka ma'am blindly follow whatever the principal says, without considering fairness or students well-being. This creates an unhealthy & uncomfortable atmosphere where students feel disturbed rather than motivated. The conduct of the principal is also deeply concerning. The language & tone used at times are inappropriate for someone in a leadership position & it sets a poor example for the entire institution. There appears to be a lack of professionalism, respect & basic etiquette in interactions. A principal is expected to create a positive & respectful environment, but here the leadership style instead contributes to discomfort & dissatisfaction among students. You can basically say that the principal & teachers don't deserve to be here in this position at all. Ironically the only person who showed basic respect & professionalism was the peon of the college. Overall the environment is toxic, disrespectful & not suitable for students who actually want to learn & grow. I would strongly advise students not to take admission here & to choose a better institution. Honestly, this college doesn't even deserve a single star. I've only given one star because it's required to proceed with posting the review on this platform.

featured_reviews.name: Poonam Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Firstly, who is this Bhoopendra  Chandan?   There is no record of such a teacher having worked at our school, and I believe this is a fake review.
As I am a part of NES International School, Mumbai, since September 2009, I can confidently say that our institution values integrity and dedication.
I have been a proud member of NES International School, Mumbai, since September 2009, and I consider this institution to be my second home. Throughout my 17 years here, the school has always been considerate and supportive. Despite living in Ulhasnagar and commuting all the way to Mulund West, my passion for teaching and the support from the school management motivate me to make this journey every day.
At the end of the day, I find immense satisfaction in guiding my students not only in their subject content but also in their personal growth. I strive to help them create a better and more peaceful world through intercultural understanding and respect. I truly cherish the moments I spend with my students, especially when I see them thriving in various parts of the world.
I would like to express my appreciation for NES International School, Mumbai, where the administration actively recognizes and rewards teachers based on their abilities and performances. I have had the privilege of attending numerous gatherings organized to honor the hard work and dedication of the teaching staff.
Additionally, the school has arranged enriching trips for teachers, accompanied by school authorities, which not only foster camaraderie but also enhance our professional development. I firmly believe in the values of hard work and dedication in my teaching profession at NES International School, and I am grateful for the supportive environment that encourages our growth and commitment.

Ms. Poonam Singh
